Why GreenGuard USA Exists

Why GreenGuard USA exists

Lauren Hughes founded GreenGuard USA in 2025 after years of watching families across Austin fight a losing battle against mosquitoes, including her own. Over 25 years in Central Texas raising two kids and a dog, she watched summer evenings get harder to enjoy. Mosquitoes took over, and being outside after sunset meant constantly getting swarmed.

What Lauren noticed was not just more mosquitoes, but fewer of the things families actually want around their homes. Bees, butterflies, and fireflies became harder to find. Neighbors were spraying more pesticides, but the mosquitoes kept coming back while pollinators disappeared.

That search led her to CO₂ mosquito trapping, a system that mimics human breath to specifically attract and capture mosquitoes without pesticides, without toxic residue, and without harming pollinators or beneficial insects. For the first time, she found something that actually worked while protecting the environment instead of damaging it.
